name: blockwork
description: Edit Gutenberg in an active editor or a background document, including selections, annotations, settings, shared entities, media, and terms. Uses the internal app browser by default.

interface.longDescription: A desktop plugin for active Gutenberg drafts and background document editing. Uses native block registrations, permissions, editor locks, prepared receipts, and separate editor and persistence verification. Active-editor requests preserve pending work and leave the tab open. Publication changes require an explicit request. Includes settings, shared entities, media, and taxonomy operations.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Blockwork to inspect the block editor for a page on my WordPress site.
